title: The Lazarus Project
description: A death-row inmate (Paul Walker) searches for the truth after he mysteriously awakes in a psychiatric hospital.

title: Lost & Found
description: To rebuild their family fortune, teenage brothers hunt for treasure while spending the summer on a remote island.

title: The Last Dragonslayer
description: A young orphan girl (Ellise Chappell), indentured servant to a magician, discovers that she's destined to become the last dragonslayer in a world with only one remaining dragon.

title: Alpha
description: Left for dead, a Cro-Magnon teen forms an unlikely alliance with a lone wolf that was abandoned by its pack. Facing overwhelming odds and nonstop danger, the boy and the wolf must now trek through a harsh landscape to make it home before winter.

title: Lake Placid
description: A New York paleontologist (Bridget Fonda) goes to the backwoods of Maine and teams up with the local game warden (Bill Pullman) to stop a 35-foot killer crocodile.

title: Miss Bala
description: A woman finds herself in big trouble when a cartel leader forces her to do his dirty work to save her kidnapped friend. Determined to get away, she must now play a dangerous game to outwit the gang -- and the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity.

title: Snatch
description: An unlicensed boxing promoter gets involved with a big-time criminal, and a heist goes awry when a valuable jewel is missing.

title: The Natural
description: The almost mythical ability of a middle-aged baseball player rockets a major-league team toward the 1939 pennant.

title: In the Line of Fire
description: An assassin toys with a White House Secret Service agent haunted for 30 years by his failure in 1963 Dallas.

title: Roman J. Israel, Esq.
description: Roman J. Israel is an idealistic defense attorney who joins another law firm after the death of his boss and mentor. Israel's legacy of activism soon gets put to the test when he takes on the case of Langston Bailey, a young man accused of murder.

title: Mortal Thoughts
description: Best friends (Demi Moore, Glenne Headly) in New Jersey get in trouble after one's rotten husband (Bruce Willis) goes too far.

title: Swept From the Sea
description: Locals disapprove of the love between an indentured servant (Rachel Weisz) and the shipwrecked Russian (Vincent Perez) she rescued in 19th-century England.

title: The Waterdance
description: Paralyzed by a hiking accident, a young writer (Eric Stoltz) struggles to adjust among other men in a hospital ward.

title: Crazy in Alabama
description: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.

title: Places in the Heart
description: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm with a laborer and a blind boarder in the 1930s Texas.

title: Brian's Song
description: Gale Sayers (Mekhi Phifer) of the Chicago Bears befriends his teammate Brian Piccolo (Sean Maher), who is dying of cancer.

title: Crossroads
description: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

title: Spanglish
description: A single mother (Paz Vega) becomes a housekeeper for a laid-back chef (Adam Sandler) and his neurotic wife (Téa Leoni).

title: Julie & Julia
description: A woman in Queens, N.Y., sets a deadline of one year to prepare all 524 recipes in Julia Child's famous cookbook, "Mastering the Art of French Cooking."

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling salesman takes custody of his son as he's poised to begin a life-changing professional career.

title: In the Line of Fire
description: An assassin toys with a White House Secret Service agent haunted for 30 years by his failure in 1963 Dallas.

title: First Daughter
description: A female Secret Service agent (Mariel Hemingway) and a river guide (Doug Savant) must rescue the president's kidnapped daughter (Monica Keena).

title: First Shot
description: A military rebel group resurfaces with a vengeance to assassinate the president for the death of their brothers. Agent McGregor, the head of the Secret Service, tries to prevent attacks on the president's life.

title: First Target
description: A Secret Service agent trains long and hard to protect the president, only to realize too late that the opening of new mountain transport in Seattle is just a ploy to ambush him.

title: White Water Summer
description: An outdoor guide (Kevin Bacon) leads a city boy (Sean Astin) and three peers on a program to toughen them up.

title: Fatal Contact: Bird Flu in America
description: An outbreak of avian flu mutates into a virus that becomes transmittable from human to human.

title: The Take
description: During his rehabilitation after he is shot during a heist in East L.A., an armored truck driver tracks down the man who committed the crime.

title: Hero
description: An anonymous loser (Dustin Hoffman) sees another man (Andy Garcia) get credit for his rescue of a TV newswoman (Geena Davis) and others from a plane crash.

title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
description: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas).

title: Spanglish
description: A single mother (Paz Vega) becomes a housekeeper for a laid-back chef (Adam Sandler) and his neurotic wife (Téa Leoni).

title: Miss Bala
description: A woman finds herself in big trouble when a cartel leader forces her to do his dirty work to save her kidnapped friend. Determined to get away, she must now play a dangerous game to outwit the gang -- and the DEA agents who suspect her of complicity.

title: Cold Comes the Night
description: A motel owner and her daughter are taken hostage by a blind thief to be his eyes while he tracks down his cash.

title: Little Nikita
description: An FBI agent (Sidney Poitier) finds a dormant link between an Air Force Academy applicant's (River Phoenix) parents and the KGB.

title: The Deal
description: Laura's family dies in a fire while living in Spain, and as she prepares to move back to the United States, she learns their deaths were not accidental. She goes undercover to find out the truth and becomes embroiled in mob crimes.

title: Side Out
description: A former basketball star (C. Thomas Howell) and a down-and-outer (Peter Horton) enter a California beach volleyball tournament.

title: Cops and Robbersons
description: Police partners move in with a would-be policeman (Chevy Chase) and his family to monitor a criminal next door.

title: Perfect
description: A Rolling Stone reporter (John Travolta) seduces an aerobics instructor (Jamie Lee Curtis) while doing a story on health clubs for singles.

title: Running With Scissors
description: A man looks back on his unusual childhood, his mentally ill mother (Annette Bening) and her unorthodox therapist (Brian Cox).

title: The Throwaways
description: Given a choice to work for the CIA or go to prison, a notorious hacker (Sam Huntington) accepts the job but turns the tables on his employers by assembling a team comprised of poorly regarded individuals.

title: Lake Placid 2
description: Man-eating crocodiles return to the lake, as two males and one aggressive female crocodile protecting their nest, wreak havoc on the locals.
